newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips move higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips move higher in late trading.

text.p: U.S. blue chips moved higher in late trading on Thursday, shaking off a brief case of inflation jitters earlier in the session.
The Dow was up about 33 points at 6760 after sinking to negative territory earlier on cautious comments on inflation from Fed governor Laurence Meyer.
The long bond was off 12/32 to yield 6.82 percent.
Eastman Kodak, reacting to strong earnings, led the Dow higher, gaining 4-1/4 to 85-1/2.
The Nasdaq composite rose almost eight points to 1341.
